requirements.requirement: The system must include a proximity object in each clinical trial response returned by evaluate_care_facade when proximity data is available.
The system must populate proximity.distance_miles, proximity.duration_minutes, and proximity.normalized_score fields exactly as produced by clinical_trials_service.
The system must preserve the original clinical trial fields and append proximity data without removing or renaming existing attributes.
The system must ensure the proximity.normalized_score value is returned as a numeric value between 0 and 100 inclusive.
The system must route enriched clinical trial objects through tool_router without schema validation errors.
The system must return a list of clinical trials where each item consistently includes the proximity field when at least one trial has computed proximity.
The system must serialize proximity metadata (including route_source and timestamp) in the response when present in the underlying schema.
The system must not recompute proximity scores within evaluate_care_facade and must only pass through values from clinical_trials_service.
The system must return proximity as null or omit the proximity field when upstream proximity data is unavailable for a trial.
The system must successfully return clinical trial results even if proximity data is missing for all trials.
The system must handle partial proximity data (e.g., missing duration_minutes) by returning null for missing fields without failing the entire response.
The system must ensure that tool_router returns enriched trial objects containing proximity data in the same response structure expected by the frontend.
The system must maintain response latency within existing facade performance thresholds after adding proximity data.
The system must log an error event when proximity data fails to attach due to schema mismatch or serialization issues.
